blockers.message: the review record has no `## code.review` section, while roles were active at it
R-ops-1 (The switch to Paylane has no way back) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it
R-ops-2 (The nightly settlement worker can fail unseen) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.evidence:
The Stripe client is deleted and replaced by the Paylane client in the same
release. There is no switch between the two: keeping both would double the
code to maintain. The Stripe account is closed the day after the release.
findings.location: design.md#Decision: All traffic moves at deploy
findings.recommendation: Keep a way back for the switch-over: keep the Stripe client behind a configuration switch (or keep the previous release deployable against a live Stripe account), and close the Stripe account only once Paylane has run in production for an agreed period with its settlement checked. Scenario that fails: Paylane rejects or times out on authorizations two days after the release; redeploying the previous version calls a closed Stripe account, so every card payment fails and no configuration change restores payments.
findings.title: The switch to Paylane has no way back

findings.evidence:
A new worker, `settlement-worker`, runs at 02:00, fetches the day's Paylane
payments and matches them to orders. It runs as a Kubernetes CronJob and
writes its result to the database.
findings.location: design.md#Decision: A worker settles payments nightly
findings.recommendation: Decide in the design how an operator sees the worker fail or not run: a log at start and end with run id and counts, a metric of the last successful run and of payments settled/unmatched, and an alert when a run fails or no successful run happened in the last 24 hours. Scenario that fails: the Paylane API is unreachable at 02:00 or the CronJob is never scheduled; the job exits with an error or does not start, nothing alerts, and the day's payments stay unreconciled until finance notices days later.
findings.title: The nightly settlement worker can fail unseen
